audit_log_actor_shape.name: audit_log_actor_shape
audit_log_actor_shape.value:
("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_log"."actor_process" is not null and "audit_log"."actor_id" is null and "audit_log"."api_key_id" is null and "audit_log"."actor_via" is null)
        or ("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'user' and "audit_log"."actor_process" is null and "audit_log"."api_key_id" is null and "audit_log"."actor_requested_by" is null)
        or ("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'api_key' and "audit_log"."actor_process" is null and "audit_log"."actor_requested_by" is null)

user_deletion_shape.name: user_deletion_shape
user_deletion_shape.value:
("user"."deleted_at" is null and "user"."deletion_mode" is null)
        or ("user"."deleted_at" is not null and "user"."deletion_mode" in ('scrubbed', 'records_kept') and not "user"."is_active")

user_scrub_schedule_shape.name: user_scrub_schedule_shape
user_scrub_schedule_shape.value:
("user"."scrub_scheduled_at" is null and "user"."scrub_requested_by" is null)
        or ("user"."scrub_scheduled_at" is not null and "user"."deleted_at" is null and not "user"."is_active")
